items.title: Trump praises ‘great relationship’ with Putin after meeting, as Ukraine war takes center stage
items.summary: SHENZHEN, China — U.S. President Donald Trump met with Vladimir Putin and Xi Jinping individually on Thursday, ahead of a scheduled trilateral with his Russian and Chinese counterparts, according to pool notes and Chinese state media.

items.title: I watched Trump, Xi and Putin gather in China. Here are my top takeaways
items.summary: SHENZHEN, China — It took a trip to China for me, an American, to see U.S. President Donald Trump in person for the first time.

items.title: Fed officials expect more rate hikes, worry about AI impact on inflation, minutes show
items.summary: Federal Reserve officials expressed confidence in October that further interest rate increases will be needed to stem inflation, though they decided to hold off while gathering more information, according to meeting minutes released Wednesday.

items.title: Tech outages are causing people to panic-buy. Costco is benefiting, Mizuho says
items.summary: A series of tech outages has consumers stocking up on emergency supplies. Costco sales are seeing a lift because of it, according to research firm Mizuho.

items.title: Fed’s Waller says central bank may need to ‘shock people’ with half-point rate hike
items.summary: Federal Reserve Governor Christopher Waller on Wednesday called for aggressive action against inflation , saying the central bank needs to "shock people" as prices continue to rise more than he expected.

items.title: Peterson: The Fed's chairman sees an AI revolution coming. Now he has to figure out what it means
items.summary: Artificial intelligence is about to sweep through the economy. The Federal Reserve is bracing for impact.

items.title: Peterson: Nvidia’s leadership crisis tests the chipmaker’s role as the ‘central bank of AI’
items.summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang 's shock resignation is raising a worrying question: Could trouble at the chipmaker spread through the tightly connected financial network Nvidia has built to support the artificial intelligence boom?

items.title: ‘Nvidia’s turmoil has me spooked’: Should I sell my stocks and buy real estate — or ride out the storm?
Nvidia’s stock falls further. It has lost $611 billion in six trading days.
